title: Amazon says Leo reached 396 satellites in low-Earth orbit following a recent launch, which is "enough to support continuous service across initial latitudes" (Thomas Ricker/The Verge)
summary: Thomas Ricker / The Verge: Amazon says Leo reached 396 satellites in low-Earth orbit following a recent launch, which is “enough to support continuous service across initial latitudes” — Early adopters of Amazon Leo should temper expectations. … Amazon says it now has enough satellites operating …
contentText:
Thomas Ricker / The Verge :

Amazon says Leo reached 396 satellites in low-Earth orbit following a recent launch, which is “enough to support continuous service across initial latitudes”   —  Early adopters of Amazon Leo should temper expectations. … Amazon says it now has enough satellites operating …
